data.name: Hujayyah
data.gender_notes: Hujayyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hujayyah is derived from the Arabic word hajja, which means 'to protect, shelter, or provide refuge'. In Islamic context, it can refer to seeking refuge in Allah or to protect others. The name Hujayyah carries the meaning “Protection, refuge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hujayyah usually hope their child will grow to embody protection, refuge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hujayyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protection, refuge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hujayyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
